entities.name: Query NUDT19-like protein
observations: 369 aa protein with NUDT19_Nudix domain PF30669.1 at residues 12–261 and NUDT19_C domain PF30668.1 at residues 290–349.
Matches reviewed human NUDT19 (UniProt A8MXV4) at 68.8% identity over 100% query coverage; E-value 1.5e-181.
Sequence contains a conserved Nudix hydrolase region and is predicted to be an acyl-CoA diphosphatase.

entities.name: NUDT19
observations: Reviewed mammalian NUDT19 homologs are fatty acyl-CoA diphosphatases.
They hydrolyze fatty acyl-CoA to acyl-4'-phosphopantetheine and adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate.
Reported cofactors include Mg2+ and Mn2+; human NUDT19 is associated with the peroxisomal matrix.

entities.name: Acyl-CoA diphosphatase reaction
observations: General reaction: acyl-CoA + H2O → acyl-4'-phosphopantetheine + adenosine 3',5'-bisphosphate + 2 H+.
Rhea reference for the general acyl-CoA reaction: RHEA:50044.
Specific mapped examples include butanoyl-CoA, hexanoyl-CoA, and octanoyl-CoA hydrolysis.
